$commentaire: Modèle de données de l’application autonome Mes projets (PRINCE2). Lu par le socle (api/src/socle/applications.mjs) : tables AA_MP_…, catalogue PRINCE2 standard (lecture seule) et règles d’instanciation. Catalogue tiré de fonctionnalites/prince2.ts (vérifié par donnees.spec.ts).

refThemes.question: Why?
refThemes.but: Establish mechanisms to judge whether the project is (and remains) desirable, viable and achievable, as a means to support decision-making in its (continued) investment.

refThemes.question: Who?
refThemes.but: Define and establish the project’s structure of accountability and responsibilities: who directs, who manages, who delivers, and how everyone communicates.

refThemes.question: What?
refThemes.but: Define and implement the means by which the project will create and verify products that are fit for purpose.

refThemes.question: How? How much? When?
refThemes.but: Facilitate communication and control by defining the means of delivering the products: where, how, by whom, when and for how much.

refThemes.question: What if?
refThemes.but: Identify, assess and control uncertainty, threats and opportunities alike, to improve the project’s ability to succeed.

refThemes.question: What’s the impact?
refThemes.but: Identify, assess and control any potential and approved changes to the project baselines (the approved products).

refThemes.question: Where are we now? Where are we going? Should we carry on?
refThemes.but: Establish mechanisms to monitor and compare actual achievements against those planned, forecast the project’s objectives and viability, and control any unacceptable deviations.

refProcessus.resume: Check that the project is worth initiating: the mandate, the team, the approach and the plan for initiation.
The Project Board authorizes initiation, the project, each stage and closure, and gives direction.
Lay the foundations: the management approaches, the controls, the Project Plan and the detailed Business Case.
Assign the work, monitor progress, handle issues and risks, report to the Project Board.
The team accepts a Work Package, builds the products, checks their quality and delivers them.
Review the stage, plan the next one (or an Exception Plan) and update the Project Plan and Business Case.
Get the project product accepted, evaluate the project, recommend follow-on actions and release the team.

refThemeProcessus.action: Outline the Business Case from the project mandate.
Check that the project remains justified at every decision.
Refine the Business Case and define how benefits will be managed.
Update the Business Case and the benefits at the end of each stage.
Confirm the benefits achieved and plan the post-project benefits review.
Appoint the Executive and the Project Manager, design the project management team.
The Project Board carries out its decision-making responsibilities.
Define the Communication Management Approach.
Review the project management team for the next stage.
Release the resources and disband the project team.
Capture the customer’s quality expectations and the Project Product Description.
Define the Quality Management Approach and open the Quality Register.
Carry out the quality checks on the products and record them.
Check that the stage’s products are approved.
Obtain acceptance of the project product.
Plan the initiation stage.
Create the Project Plan and its Product Descriptions.
The team creates its plan for the Work Package (optional).
Plan the next stage, or produce an Exception Plan.
Record the first risks in the Daily Log.
Define the Risk Management Approach and open the Risk Register.
Monitor risks, identify new ones, implement the responses.
Reassess the project risks before the next stage.
The Project Board decides on risks that exceed tolerances.
Record the first issues in the Daily Log.
Define the Change Control Approach and configuration management.
Capture, examine and handle issues and requests for change.
Keep the Configuration Item Records of delivered products up to date.
The Project Board decides on requests for change beyond delegated authority.
Set tolerances and decide at each Project Board control point.
Authorize Work Packages, monitor progress, report to the Project Board.
The team reports its progress to the Project Manager.
Review the stage and capture its lessons.
Evaluate the project and pass on the lessons learned.

refPrincipes.resume: The project remains justified from start to finish.
Lessons are sought, recorded and acted upon.
Everyone knows who directs, who manages and who delivers.
The project is planned, monitored and controlled stage by stage.
Tolerances are set at each level; only deviations beyond them are escalated.
Products are defined and delivered with their quality criteria.
The method is tailored to the project’s size, complexity and risk.
